# ya-runtime-vm 0.5.4

This release updates the bundled QEMU from 8.1.1 to 11.1.2 and restores the
default 128 MiB writable rootfs overlay. Explicit storage-backed rootfs overlays
continue to use the configured disk.

- Update the static Linux x86_64 `vmrt` binary and bundled BIOS files.
- Build QEMU from its pinned upstream release commit during release packaging.
- Synchronize the runtime descriptor version with the Cargo package version for
  both the Linux archive and Debian package.
- Parse rootfs layer indices without relying on musl-specific `sscanf` behavior,
  reject truncated mount paths, and close storage-scan file descriptors.
- Refresh release automation and publish a stable release after both packages
  have been uploaded.

## Upgrading from 0.4.4

Finish active tasks before replacing the complete runtime package. Deploy new
activities after upgrading: the 0.5 deployment JSON format differs from 0.4.
The 0.5 line uses virtio networking and requires explicit network endpoints;
Yagna 0.18.1 supplies these endpoints. The environment-variable fix from 0.5.3
is included.

GPU workloads were not validated for this release. The known issue with attaching
userspace NVIDIA files remains unresolved.

## Validation

The new QEMU and patched C init were built on Linux x86_64. The C cyclic-buffer
tests and runtime self-test passed. Isolated KVM smoke tests covered two rootfs
layers, environment variables, root permissions, hostname, 9p writes, RAM volumes,
the default 128 MiB limit, a 140 MiB write to a storage-backed overlay, outgoing
VPN/INET UDP frames, and VM shutdown after entrypoint exit.
